info.name: Tanghiers Forecast API
info.description:
Generated from the OpenAPI spec by scripts/generate-postman.py.

1. Import this collection and an environment (Local or Render) and select the environment.
2. Set userEmail/userPassword (and adminEmail/adminPassword) in the environment.
3. Sign in with *1. Auth → Login* (user) or folder *3* (admin). Tokens are saved for you; every other request picks them up automatically.

Responses are wrapped: `{ success, data, timestamp }`.
